command: set -uo pipefail; fail=0; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do if pnpm -w test > /tmp/m24-web-$i.log 2>&1; then echo "RUN $i PASS"; grep -E "Test Files|Tests " /tmp/m24-web-$i.log; else echo "RUN $i FAIL"; tail -100 /tmp/m24-web-$i.log; fail=1; break; fi; done; if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi; pnpm -w typecheck || exit 1; pnpm --filter @riccon/web run lint || exit 1; echo web-5x-ok
note: M04 F-012/M22 F-001：workspace 先等部门名再断言；测试 setup 放宽异步查询等待上限至 3s（不改断言/不重试/不降并行）；web 全量 5 次无 flake；typecheck+lint
